settings.title: Settings
settings.restartBody: Close and reopen Yusr to apply the new layout direction.
settings.pendingBody: Some changes haven't reached the server yet. Signing out now will lose them. Sign out anyway?
settings.privacyHint: Hides giving amounts and recipients on screen. Totals such as net still include giving.
settings.hijriHint: Move Hijri dates by a day to match your local moon sighting.
settings.remindersHint: Gentle reminders for payments, giving and bills. They never show amounts or names.
settings.remindersOffBody: Allow notifications for Yusr in your phone's settings to get reminders.
settings.exportHint: Shares a JSON copy of everything in your account, including encrypted notes, with the app you choose.
settings.exportFailedBody: Check your connection and try again.

auth.switchToSignUp: New to Yusr? Create an account
auth.switchToSignIn: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.checkEmail: Check your email to confirm your account, then sign in.

errors.cannotCreate: We couldn't create that account. Try signing in instead.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.network: Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.consentNeeded: Please confirm all three to create your account.

consent.terms: I accept the Terms of Service

home.noAccountsBody: Add an account to start recording income and expenses.
home.safeHint: Income so far this month, minus what you have spent and what is still due this month. A guide, not a promise.
home.upcomingEmpty: Nothing due in the next 7 days.

transactions.emptyBody: Tap + to record your first one.
transactions.amountInvalid: Enter an amount greater than zero.
transactions.deleteBody: It will be removed from your totals.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.name: Name
accounts.openingInvalid: Enter a valid amount, for example 1,250.00.
accounts.archiveBody: It will be hidden from lists. Its transactions are kept.

categories.title: Categories
categories.name: Name
categories.archiveBody: It will be hidden from lists. Existing transactions keep it.

debts.neverFree: At this pace the debts won't clear. A higher monthly amount would help.
debts.emptyBody: Add what you owe so it is all in one place.
debts.monthlyHint: Never less than your minimum payments.
debts.assumptions: Assumes the same payment every month from next month, and the interest rate you entered. This is guidance, not advice.

strategyNote.snowball: Extra money goes to the smallest balance first.
strategyNote.avalanche: Extra money goes to the highest interest rate first.
strategyNote.riba_first: Extra money goes to interest-bearing debt first, then the smallest balance.

debts.secretsHint: The reference number and notes are stored encrypted.
debts.lenderRequired: Enter who the debt is owed to.
debts.amountInvalid: Enter a valid amount, for example 1,250.00.
debts.nudge: Debt with interest can grow over time. Clearing it first may lighten what you owe.
debts.archiveBody: It will be hidden from lists. Your payments are kept.
debts.receivedBody: It will be removed from the list.

giving.emptyBody: Plan your sadaqah or zakat and be reminded gently.
giving.archiveBody: It will be hidden from lists. What you already gave is kept.
giving.guidance: A planning aid, not a religious ruling. For zakat amounts, ask a scholar.

reminders.title: Yusr
reminders.giving: A reminder to give is due today.

recurring.title: Bills & income
recurring.emptyBody: Add rent, utilities or your salary to be reminded and to see what is still due.
recurring.name: Name
recurring.archiveBody: It will stop appearing and stop reminding you. Entries you logged are kept.

wasiyyah.title: Wasiyyah & Amanah
wasiyyah.intro: A calm place to keep what your family would need to know: what you owe, what is owed to you, and any giving still pending. Debts are settled first. Yusr does not give rulings or work out inheritance shares; for those, ask a qualified scholar.
wasiyyah.notAutomatic: Nothing is released to your trusted contacts automatically yet. For now, use Share to send your register to the people you choose.
wasiyyah.stepNote: Write a note for your family
wasiyyah.noteHint: Who should be called first? Anything about missed fasts or fidya? Anything else your family should know. This note is stored encrypted.
wasiyyah.contactsEmptyBody: Choose up to three people you trust. They can see nothing unless your register is released.
wasiyyah.revokeBody: They will no longer be able to accept, and will not see your register.
wasiyyah.consent: I have their permission to store their name and email in Yusr so they can be a trusted contact.
wasiyyah.linkHint: Send this link to them yourself. It is shown only once, works once, and expires in 7 days.
wasiyyah.inviteMessage: {{name}} has invited you to be a trusted contact on Yusr. Open this link to accept or decline: {{link}}
wasiyyah.notSetUp: Invite links are not set up yet in this version of the app.
wasiyyah.consentRequired: Please confirm you have their permission.
wasiyyah.tooMany: You can have at most three trusted contacts.
wasiyyah.needOnline: You need to be online to do this.
wasiyyah.shareWarn: This leaves Yusr. Anyone who can see the message can read it, so send it only to people you trust.
wasiyyah.preview: This is exactly what will be sent
wasiyyah.shareNothing: Choose at least one section to share.
wasiyyah.shareFailed: Could not record this share. Connect to the internet and try again.

shareLabels.title: Wasiyyah & Amanah register
shareLabels.footer: Shared from Yusr. This is a record, not a religious or legal ruling.

wasiyyah.activityHint: A record of changes to your register and trusted contacts. It cannot be edited.

events.register_viewed: A trusted contact viewed your register

deleteAccount.intro: Deleting your account removes your data from Yusr. You have 7 days to change your mind.

items.debts: Debts and what is owed to you, including encrypted reference numbers and notes
items.audit: The audit log and your consent records

deleteAccount.graceNote: Everything is erased 7 days after you confirm. Until then you can keep your account from Home or Settings. Anything you already shared outside Yusr stays with the people you sent it to.
deleteAccount.pendingBody: Your account and data will be erased on {{date}}.
deleteAccount.failedBody: Check your connection and try again.
